limitations.note: The rewrite registered `valid_b` but also tied `ready_a` high through reset and suppressed `valid_b` on idle clocks at count five, whereas the correct fix preserves registered `ready_a` and registers `cnt == 5` without gating it on `valid_a`.

The test exercised reset and gaps after five bits, but its expectations encoded the rewrite’s always-high ready and completion-only valid, so passing all 64 data patterns did not verify the timing the fix needed to preserve.

limitations.quote: The fix ties ready high, keeps the first five accepted bits in a shift register, and captures the output with a one-cycle valid pulse when the sixth bit arrives.
limitations.note: The agent followed this earlier serial-packer recipe even though another entry it read explicitly warned that tying ready high and pulsing valid only on acceptance had caused grading mismatches.
